newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 slips back as SPT, CEZ decline.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 slips back as SPT, CEZ decline.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index on Thursday fell back below the 500 mark led by declines from the two most heavily weighted shares, SPT Telecom and CEZ.
SPT fell 38 crowns to 3,630 while CEZ lost three crowns to 899.

The PX50's third most heavily capitalised banking issue, IPB posted solid gains after the government announced that it has given the go-ahead for Japan's Nomura Securities Co Ltd International to buy a 36 percent state stake in IPB. The deal should be done by August 1
IPB rose seven crowns, 2.9 percent, to 243. The bank accounts for 4.6 perecnt of the PX50's capitalisation.
